mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.3% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.3% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.3% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 2022-12-15 value over six months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below 473808 for six consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS < 473808 for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 2022-12-15 value over six months signals improving manufacturing activity and economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above 105.0284 for six consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 105.0284 for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 0.91% over three months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.91% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.91% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 2022-12-15 value over six months signals labor market strength, which boosts consumer demand and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises above 146135 for six consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 146135 for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 2022-12-15 value over six months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces economic growth and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1172 for six consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST < 1172 for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above its 2022-12-15 value over six months signals persistent inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises above 243.846 for six consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL > 243.846 for six months (t-test p > 0.05).
